text_en: So it's true. You've completed the bounty board.
It makes me proud that you've been willing to pay back Hafin's favour to us.
You have settled our debt with this city, so I shall honour my promise.
Soldier of Zarga, as General of the kingdom's army, it is my honour to present you with the Shimmering Blade of Zarga.
I know you'll put it to good use.
